verdict.rationale: A public status page with uptime history and incident postmortems is a fair question for a hosted browser-infrastructure service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a status page, uptime history, or postmortems. Session observability, webhooks, and customer-facing monitoring agents are different features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can check a public status page showing uptime history and past incident postmortems before committing to the service
